dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Joubert syndrome (autosomal recessive ciliopathy)
Alternatives:
1. COACH syndrome (Joubert syndrome with hepatic fibrosis and ocular coloboma)
2. Senior-Løken syndrome (Joubert-related ciliopathy with nephronophthisis and retinal dystrophy)
3. Other ciliopathy presenting with the molar tooth sign (e.g., Dekaban-Arima syndrome or a CEP290/NPHP1-related ciliopathy)
